title: SetupCommandToSlackWebhook
description: A slash command posted to project-added, decoded from its form body (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; if a key repeats, its last value wins) after the signature check over the raw body. /setup opens the setup modal with views.open; any other command gets a private reply. Only the fields read are described; every other field is allowed and ignored.

channel_id.description: The channel /setup was run in; carried through the modal's private_metadata.

trigger_id.description: Lets views.open show a modal, within 3 seconds of the command.
